name: Agent — Run (manual form, wait for result)

parameters.formDescription: Starts a sandboxed agent. The result is pushed to ntfy topic agent-runs.

values.formSubmittedText: Started. The result will arrive as an ntfy push (topic agent-runs).

parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_runs (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, agent TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT, event_type TEXT, subject TEXT, started TIMESTAMPTZ, finished TIMESTAMPTZ, exit_reason TEXT, outcome TEXT, summary TEXT, outputs JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_runs_created_idx ON agent_runs (created_at DESC);

INSERT INTO agent_runs (run_id, agent, event_id, event_type, subject, started, finished, exit_reason, outcome, summary, outputs) SELECT p->>'run_id', p->>'agent', p->>'event_id', p->>'event_type', p->>'subject', (p->>'started')::timestamptz, (p->>'finished')::timestamptz, p->>'exit_reason', p->>'outcome', p->>'summary', COALESCE(p->'outputs', '[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p) AS s ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING run_id, agent, outcome, exit_reason, summary, outputs;
